name: Leak Guard
description: Checks text an agent sends to another agent for secrets and personal data, by group (secrets, structured-pii, contextual-pii), with a mode per group: block, approve, warn or off. Deterministic; blocks text it can't read.

groups.description: Per-group mode and kinds. An unknown mode or kind falls back to the group's default.

mode.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

kinds.description: Kinds to check. Default: matrix-token and credential.

gitleaks.description: Optional second detector for the credential kind: a gitleaks release binary run as a separate process. The plugin downloads nothing. Without a binary, only secretlint runs, and a warning is logged at startup.

binary.description: Absolute path to a gitleaks 8.30.1 executable whose SHA-256 you have verified against the release's checksums file.

mode.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

kinds.description: Kinds to check. Default: every structured-pii kind but ip-address.

mode.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

kinds.description: Kinds to check. None exist yet.

targets.description: Per receiving agent id: a mode per group that replaces the group's own, such as {"helper": {"structured-pii": "off"}}.

secrets.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

structured-pii.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

contextual-pii.description: block: refuse the call. approve: ask the owner first (allow once or deny; a timeout denies). warn: let the call through and log the kind, never the value. off: do not check the group.

allowTargets.description: Deprecated: use targets. Agent ids whose incoming text is not checked by any group.

kinds.description: Deprecated: use groups.<group>.kinds. The kinds to check, split into their groups.
